ivysaur: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flowers coming bloom.
venusaur: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokemon.
charmander: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
charmeleon: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
charizard: It is said that Charizards fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
squirtle: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
wartortle: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
blastoise: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
caterpie: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
metapod: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
butterfree: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
weedle: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
kakuna: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
beedrill: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
pidgey: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
pidgeotto: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
pidgeot: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
rattata: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.
raticate: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokemon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.
spearow: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
fearow: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
ekans: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
arbok: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
pikachu: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
raichu: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
sandshrew: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.
sandslash: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.
nidoran-f: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
nidorina: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorinos.
nidoqueen: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
nidoran-m: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
nidorino: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
nidoking: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
clefairy: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.
clefable: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so theyre usually found in quiet places.
vulpix: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.
ninetales: Each of its nine tails is imbued with supernatural power, and it can live for a thousand years.
jigglypuff: Looking into its cute, round eyes makes it start singing a song so pleasant listeners cant help but fall asleep.
wigglytuff: Its fine fur feels so pleasant, those who accidentally touch it cannot take their hands away.
zubat: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surroundings while it flies.
golbat: Flitting around in the dead of night, it sinks its fangs into its prey and drains a nearly fatal amount of blood.
oddish: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
gloom: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
vileplume: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
paras: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.
parasect: A mushroom grown larger than the hosts body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
venonat: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
venomoth: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
diglett: A Pokemon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
dugtrio: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
meowth: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
persian: A very haughty Pokemon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
psyduck: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.
golduck: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.
mankey: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
primeape: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
growlithe: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.
arcanine: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
poliwag: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
poliwhirl: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
poliwrath: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
abra: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
kadabra: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
alakazam: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
machop: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
machoke: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
machamp: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
bellsprout: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
weepinbell: A Pokemon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
victreebel: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honey-like scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
tentacool: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
tentacruel: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
geodude: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
graveler: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokemon can stop it without difficulty.
golem: Even dynamite cant harm its hard, boulder-like body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
ponyta: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
rapidash: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
slowpoke: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
slowbro: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
magnemite: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.
magneton: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.
farfetchd: It cant live without the stalk it holds. Thats why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
doduo: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
dodrio: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
seel: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.
dewgong: Its streamlined body has low resistance, and it swims around cold oceans at a speed of eight knots.
grimer: Born from sludge, these Pokemon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.
muk: Its so stinky! Muks body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.
shellder: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
cloyster: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
gastly: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
haunter: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
gengar: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.
onix: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.
drowzee: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
hypno: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
krabby: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
kingler: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
voltorb: It looks just like a Pok Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.
electrode: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
exeggcute: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
exeggutor: It is called The Walking Jungle. If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
cubone: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
marowak: From its birth, this savage Pokemon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
hitmonlee: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
hitmonchan: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
lickitung: Being licked by its long, saliva-covered tongue leaves a tingling sensation. Extending its tongue retracts its tail.
koffing: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.
weezing: Inhaling toxic fumes from trash and mixing them inside its body lets it spread an even fouler stench.
rhyhorn: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
rhydon: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
chansey: A kindly Pokemon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokmon or people.
tangela: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
kangaskhan: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
horsea: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
seadra: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.
goldeen: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
seaking: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
staryu: As long as its red core remains, it can regenerate its body instantly, even if its torn apart.
starmie: Its core shines in many colors and sends radio signals into space to communicate with something.
mr-mime: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
scyther: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
jynx: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
electabuzz: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.
magmar: The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar forms heat waves around its body, making it hard to see the Pokemon clearly.
pinsir: It grips prey with its powerful pincers and will not let go until the prey is torn in half.
tauros: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
magikarp: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
gyarados: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
lapras: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.
ditto: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.
eevee: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokemon conceals many different possible evolutions.
vaporeon: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it cant be seen when it melts away into water.
jolteon: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.
flareon: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.
porygon: A man-made Pokemon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
omanyte: A Pokemon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
omastar: It is thought that this Pokemon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
kabuto: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
kabutops: It is thought that this Pokemon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
aerodactyl: A Pokemon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
snorlax: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
articuno: A legendary bird Pokemon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
zapdos: A legendary Pokemon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
moltres: One of the legendary bird Pokemon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
dratini: It is called the Mirage Pokemon because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
dragonair: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
dragonite: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.
mewtwo: A Pokemon created by recombining Mews genes. Its said to have the most savage heart among Pokmon.
mew: Mew is said to possess the genetic composition of all Pokemon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.
